runtime_scope: Original getCacheKey helper exposed from unchanged pinned utils module in Node VM. Native crypto/fs/path; inert unused-dependency adapters. No dependency installation or Webpack build.
findings: Cache key hashes only yarn.lock bytes and comma-joined patched package names, omitting root identity and installed package content. With a shared cacheDir, equal lockfiles map to the same saved absolute-path duplicate list. Helper key behavior reproduced; full build redirection not executed.
extractProperDuplicates compares package.json objects, not package source bytes. This is package consolidation policy and does not establish file identity.
Packages without dependencies property and root-level package.json are excluded, limiting duplicate enumeration. Filtered group can contain only its first package.
Resolver memoization key concatenates request and context with an unescaped delimiter and retains results without invalidation. Potential delimiter ambiguity noted statically, not executed.
Resolver temporarily changes global Error stack capture settings and restores in finally. Claimed historical speedup is not a measurement here.
